subject.title: improve(ci): preserve complete main validation during merge bursts

question: Should this CI policy change land after an authorized owner verifies the protected-main ruleset and supplies after-fix operational evidence for single-flight runs and the pinned cache writer?
rationale: The missing proof depends on protected repository settings and live CI behavior that cannot be established from the branch’s unit guards alone.

options.title: Verify and land
options.body: Have an authorized owner capture redacted protected-main and ruleset evidence, then merge if the observed run and cache SHA match the documented contract.

options.title: Pause the rollout
options.body: Keep the existing main-CI policy until the required protected-branch gate and operational evidence can be verified.

recommendation.title: Verify and land
recommendation.body: Have an authorized owner capture redacted protected-main and ruleset evidence, then merge if the observed run and cache SHA match the documented contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest visible continuity with the merged snapshot work and this proposed CI rollout.
